newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin in $251 mln weapon deal.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin in $251 mln weapon deal.

text.p: Lockheed Martin was awarded a $251 million contract for production and testing of part of the AEGIS Weapon Systems, the U.S. Defense Department said on Friday.

Lockheed Martin Government Electronic Systems, of Moorestown, N.J., is getting the contract for production and integration testing for four AEGIS Weapon Systems for the Spanish Navy's F-100 Shipbuilding Program under the Foreign Military Sales Program, the Pentagon said.
Work is expected to be completed in 2004. Contract funds will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year.
